title: Phase 2B-R1 Context Binding and Candidate Translation Fix
user_summary: Bind executor context_bundle_ref to registry format and preserve asset/relation candidates through translate_result for ORM persistence.
technical_summary: Root causes: (1) Executor invented bundle:{run_id} while Runtime registered ctx-bundle:{hash}; product path needed harness alias. (2) translate_result cleared asset/relation candidates so Phase1B never wrote Asset/Version/Evidence; orm_written true from artifact-only. Fix: make_context_bundle_ref single source; Executor/Runtime use Registry ref only; translate_result preserves candidates; book_overview maps structured claims to Candidate Assets; evidence coercion+snapshot enrichment; persistence_complete requires candidate+evidence+artifact; empty_dto rejected.
